card.fact_statement: The office contested in the 2025 Liberal Democratic Party presidential election was the president of the Liberal Democratic Party.
card.answer: president of the Liberal Democratic Party
card.source_span: to elect the next president of the Liberal Democratic Party of Japan (LDP).

target_qa_variants.question: Ni wadhifa gani maalum wa kisiasa uliogombewa katika uchaguzi wa urais wa Chama cha Kidemokrasia cha Kiliberali wa mwaka 2025?
target_qa_variants.expected_answer: rais wa Chama cha Kidemokrasia cha Kiliberali
target_qa_variants.source_span: to elect the next president of the Liberal Democratic Party of Japan (LDP).
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'political office' to 'wadhifa wa kisiasa' and 'Liberal Democratic Party' to 'Chama cha Kidemokrasia cha Kiliberali'.

backtranslation_en.question: What specific political office was contested in the 2025 presidential election of the Liberal Democratic Party?
